source_title: WWE 2K26 Officially Adds Four New DLC Wrestlers
source_excerpt:
WWE 2K26 has officially added four brand-new WWE superstars to the game as DLC, including the popular Natural Disasters tag team. The update is expected to be one of the final major DLC releases of WWE 2K26 's content cycle.
The newest entry in the annual wrestling franchise has added a plethora of new wrestlers to the game following its launch. WWE 2K26 has launched multiple DLC packs containing special wrestlers, including the WrestleMania 42 pack , which contained personas of Cody Rhodes and Alexa Bliss based on their appearance at the event. The game's Ringside Passes have served as one of the main ways of adding new wrestlers to the game, with each season typically introducing four WWE superstars alongside new personas for wrestlers already in the game. Now, WWE 2K26 is rolling out the final season of Ringside Pass.
WWE 2K26 Debuts Ringside Pass Season 6
WWE 2K26 launched the newest edition of the game's Ringside Pass on October 28, officially debuting Season 6 within the game. The newest seasonal pass for the game includes four new characters for players to choose from, welcoming Earthquake and Typhoon, the tag team commonly known as The Natural Disasters. The DLC also adds multiple modern wrestlers to the franchise for the first time, including former AAA World Trios Champion Octagon Jr. and new WWE superstar Royce Keys , who signed with WWE in January 2026. The Premium Track of WWE 2K26 's Ringside Pass Season 6 is available for $9.99 on all platforms.
The newest season added more than just the highlight WWE superstars, with plenty of personas introduced as well. Both a Masked variant of AJ Styles and Bray Wyatt '23 were added to the game through the Premium track of Ringside Pass Season 6 , with the latter based on Wyatt's appearance at the 2023 Royal Rumble. The Free track also included another three Personas of beloved WWE wrestlers, introducing AJ Styles Retro, Rhea Ripley '20, and Eddie Guerrero '05.

WWE 2K26 fans were treated to a particularly unusual new batch of characters alongside Season 6 as well. Visual Concepts and 2K officially debuted the Street Fighter Elite Pack for WWE 2K26 on October 28, adding new versions of popular superstars like The Rock, Rey Mysterio, and Bianca Belair. The DLC added unique finishers for each of the featured Street Fighter characters, including the Shinku Hadoken and Psycho Crusher, which can also be used for Create-a-Superstar characters. The WWE 2K26 DLC also adds special parts for Create-a-Superstar, allowing fans to add iconic Street Fighter outfits to custom characters.
With WWE 2K26 officially launching its last major DLC, many fans will likely begin to look ahead to WWE 2K27 . Visual Concepts and 2K have not made any official statements about the 2027 edition of the game, though several WWE superstars are already expected to be leaving in WWE 2K27 . Fan-favorite WWE wrestlers like Kofi Kingston and Mick Foley will likely not be included in the roster for WWE 2K27 , following their departures from the company in 2026. WWE 2K27 's roster will likely feature plenty of differences in its roster, between old wrestlers leaving the company and new superstars joining.
